status: RECONSTRUCTION — correct against memory of the lost run
principle: These 15 traits are FIXED. They are measured EVERY cycle, without exception, whether or not anything notable happened. Dimensional consistency across all cycles is what makes the growth path derivable. Do not add traits while rebuilding. Earn expansion only after 25 fresh cycles hold.
subject_type: tree (origin node / the thing the society gathers around)
measurement_law: Every trait logged every cycle. A trait that didn't change is logged as delta 0 — never omitted. Omission breaks the trajectory.

traits.name: emergence_height
traits.what: how far the subject has risen above ground

traits.name: broke_ground
traits.what: binary — has it emerged from soil at all yet

traits.name: branch_angle_dominant
traits.what: angle of the most pronounced branch from vertical

traits.name: leaf_color_variance
traits.what: how many distinct leaf colors are present (mono vs varied)

traits.name: growth_trajectory_vector
traits.what: net direction the mass is moving (e.g. upward, lateral-left, canopy-spread)

traits.name: growth_angle_overall
traits.what: lean of the whole subject from vertical

traits.name: growth_velocity
traits.what: total mass-change rate this cycle vs last (the speed of becoming)

traits.name: symmetry_index
traits.what: how balanced left/right growth is (asymmetry signals character/age)

traits.name: anomaly_marker
traits.what: any pronounced deviation this cycle (a fork, a scar, an unexpected sport) — the seed of narrative

traits.name: categorization
traits.what: the subject's current developmental stage/class as read from the other 14 (sprout → sapling → established → elder → monument)
traits.note: DERIVED, not chosen — computed from the other traits. This is the trait that lets the society 'read' the tree.

per_cycle_record.comment: What gets logged EVERY cycle. This row is appended, never edited. The accumulation of these rows IS the preamble/ledger.
per_cycle_record.trait_deltas: object — all 15 delta fields (0 if unchanged)

commentary.perspective: Grok's read of where the subject sits now
commentary.growth: what grew and how much, in plain terms
commentary.trajectory: the clear path — where it's heading based on accumulated deltas
commentary.categorization_reasoning: why T15 stage is what it is this cycle

per_cycle_record.photography_ref: render of this cycle's state (the visible deliverable)
per_cycle_record.attention_flag: true/false — did the user observe this subject this cycle. UNATTENDED subjects are logged but NOT advanced (your law: it won't track what doesn't have attention).

the_attention_law: A subject only grows on a cycle where it received attention (attention_flag = true). Unattended subjects hold. This is why the lost tree grew where you looked — and it is now a mechanical rule, not a philosophy.
the_preamble_law: Every cycle begins by re-reading ALL prior per_cycle_records. Growth is computed against full accumulated history, never against last cycle alone. This is what made 25 cycles compound instead of drift. The ledger file IS the preamble — and it is yours, not an account's.
rebuild_discipline: 15 traits. Not 16. Hold the matrix fixed for 25 fresh cycles before considering any expansion. The lost run's power came from constraint held consistently, not from coverage.
